name: BSP_LuaBinding_DebugTrap
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet mission_lua_host, read-only analysis; docs/MISSION_LUA_HOST.md. __fastcall(lua_State*), returns 0. Registered as the global "debugtrap" by row 00e0c858 of the registration table and pushed by 00887750 as the pcall error handler for every named call. Opens a LuaStateOwner over the incoming state, calls 00887750(0, "debug.traceback", 0, 0, -1, &results, 0) through the same dotted-name dispatcher, reads the returned string and passes it to the logging helper 004254b0. The traceback is logged and swallowed.

name: BSP_LuaBinding_ScoringGrantUnlock
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the error literal in the body is "luaMW_Scoring_GrantUnlock failed:". Reads argument 0 as a Lua string, wraps it with BSP_NativeString_Assign, and inserts it into the set at game+6CCh (008CBA3E ADD ECX,0x6CC = game+650h+7Ch) through 004D0640, so a Lua-side grant lands in the pending-unlock set that 007FB990 later folds into "Unlocks".
